product.description: Monoprice™2‑Gang Low‑Voltage Mounting Bracket, BlackReliable Hardware for Retrofit and Structured Wiring ProjectsThe 2‑Gang Low‑Voltage Mounting Bracket in Black delivers a secure, reliable, and professional‑grade solution for installing low‑voltage cable plates in residential or commercial settings. Built with durability and ease of use in mind, this bracket provides a clean and efficient way to mount low‑voltage devices without the need for a full electrical box. Whether you are running network cables, speaker wires, HDMI® connections, or other low‑voltage systems, this bracket ensures a solid fit that keeps your installation neat and organized.Engineered for versatility, the 2‑Gang Low‑Voltage Mounting Bracket is compatible with drywall up to 1 inch thick, making it a dependable option for a wide range of wall types and retrofit applications. The innovative mounting wings fasten securely against the back of the drywall as you tighten the screws, ensuring a stable and secure installation every time. This design eliminates wobbling and provides a long‑lasting hold without requiring additional hardware or complex tools.Ideal for retrofit projects, the nail‑in design makes the installation quick and hassle‑free. Contractors, technicians, and DIY enthusiasts alike will appreciate how straightforward it is to position and secure this bracket. Once installed, it's ready to accept a wide variety of low‑voltage cable plates, allowing you to complete your setup with a clean, professional appearance.Another standout feature is its ability to be mounted either horizontally or vertically, providing flexibility during installation to accommodate different layouts, cable runs, and space constraints. This adaptability ensures that the 2‑Gang Low‑Voltage Mounting Bracket can be seamlessly integrated into any project, whether it's a structured wiring system, home theater installation, or office network setup.With its durable black finish, the bracket not only blends well with most installations but also adds a professional touch behind the scenes. It is specifically designed for low‑voltage use, ensuring compliance and performance without the added bulk or expense of a traditional electrical box.Whether you are a professional installer seeking dependable hardware or a DIY user looking for a simple solution to manage your cables, the 2‑Gang Low‑Voltage Mounting Bracket delivers outstanding performance, ease of use, and value.
